architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit fixture architecture: const=0, OTHER=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7 (x86-64-shaped ram/register/stack sizes); printRaw wordsize cases use synthetic IPTR_PROCESSOR spaces with addrsize 2/4/8 and wordsize 1/2/4
compiler_spec: none: AddrSpace::printRaw / getAddrSize are pure space methods; no Funcdata, P-code, or cspec input

analysis_options.api: Direct AddrSpace::printRaw / rudra::space::AddrSpace::print_raw and getAddrSize / get_addr_size + flat-enum addr_size/word_size invocation; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. Both sides print the raw byte offset unpadded lowercase hex; the printRaw result string is embedded verbatim (including setw zero-fill and the +cut suffix).
analysis_options.random_seed: none; printRaw and the constructors are deterministic

cases: addrsize_projection: getAddrSize/getWordSize over the real constructors — const=8/1 (sizeof(uintb), space.cc:357), OTHER=8/1 (space.cc:397), unique=4/1 (UniqueSpace::SIZE, space.cc:418/428), ram/register/stack=8/1 (x86-64 shape), join=4/1 (sizeof(uintm), types.h:27 + space.cc:447), iop=8/1 (sizeof(void*), op.cc:36), overlay copies its base (space.cc:661-680); plus the nine flat-enum legacy mappings

printraw_wordsize1: fixed 2*addrsize zero-filled hex width for addrsize<=4 spaces, the addrsize>4 shrink rule (offset>>32==0 -> 4 bytes, else offset>>48==0 -> 6 bytes, shrink tested on the raw byte offset), and setw minimum-width semantics (a value wider than the field prints un-padded)
printraw_wordsize2: byteToAddress(offset,2) scaling with the +cut suffix (offset%2) across addrsize 2/4/8, including the shrink rule interacting with scaling and 0xffffffff wrap
printraw_wordsize4: byteToAddress(offset,4) scaling with +cut across addrsize 4/8, including the 6-byte shrink band and 0xffffffffffffffff
printraw_overrides: ConstantSpace::printRaw / OtherSpace::printRaw overrides (space.cc:372/410) print plain unpadded hex with no scaling and no suffix
reachability_note: printRaw wordsize>1 is unreachable in the current x86-64 production closure (all loaded spec spaces and hardwired spaces are wordsize 1); the flat-enum addr_size divergence (unique/join = 4, previously hardcoded 8) was observable only in the heritage deadcode-revisit warning width, translate resolveConstant wrapping, and pcodeparse addressOf corners, never in the E2E C output. Fixed and locked per the SPACE-PRINTRAW-WORDSIZE-0001 registration.
